name: Moguer (Spain)
description: Chequy of fifteen pieces, eight yellow and seven blue, three in the height by five in the length, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Moguer (a tower, castles and lions).
history: As approved by the municipal corporation in plenary on 24 July 1996 and endorsed by the Junta de Andalucía on 15 October 1996, the flag of Moguer is rectangular in the proportion 11:18, chequy of fifteen pieces, eight yellow and seven blue, arranged three in the width by five in the length.
